package.A0: Market research, concept and design (PL1–PL3): research report, approved concept, design and brand file.
package.A1: Brand sourcing (P1–P4): an existing brand's or maker's product, approved and quality-checked.
package.A2: Private label development (P1 → PL1–PL7 → P3–P4): a product made under the customer's brand from the concept on; includes A0.
package.B: Logistics and delivery (P5–P6): goods cleared through customs and in the customer's warehouse.
package.C: Listing and market launch (L1–L5): the product live on the chosen platforms and countries.
package.D: End to end: A1 or A2 plus B and C, one contact from idea to a product ready to sell.
package.E: Ongoing management (O1–O3): reorders, listing upkeep, reporting. No project; a reorder opens a reorder project.

project_type.npi: New product: goes through the full gate set of its path.
project_type.variant: A new variant of an existing product (G2 → G5).
project_type.revision: A spec or packaging change after a change request (G2 → G5).
project_type.reorder: A repeat order of an approved product (G3 → G5).

project_path.a_sourcing: Path A, brand sourcing: supplier and sample (P2) for an existing brand's product.
project_path.b_private_label: Path B, private label: from concept to print approval (PL1–PL7) under the customer's brand.

gate_code.G1: Project start (M): brief and feasibility approved.
gate_code.G2: Sample, spec sheet and NPDS approval (M); not passed without a signed spec sheet.
gate_code.G4: Shipment release (internal): PSI passed, documents complete; approved by compliance and quality.
gate_code.G5: Delivery acceptance (M) at the customer's warehouse.
gate_code.PL_G1: Concept and design approval (M), in writing.

document_type.spec_sheet: The maker's product specification, signed and stamped: the product's evidence.
document_type.tech_pack: Design package for the maker: drawings, materials, measurements.
document_type.sample_report: Sample evaluation: how the sample compares with the spec.
document_type.pi: Proforma invoice from the supplier: quantities, prices, terms.
document_type.po: Purchase order sent to the supplier.
document_type.psi_report: Pre-shipment inspection report (AQL), with photos and video.
document_type.test_report: Laboratory test report for the product's compliance.
document_type.sds: Safety data sheet; required for chemicals.
document_type.technical_file: Technical documentation kept for market surveillance.
document_type.label_artwork: Label and packaging print file: dieline, GTIN, warnings.
document_type.packing_list: Packing list of a shipment: cartons, quantities, weights.
document_type.bill_of_lading: Bill of lading (B/L) from the carrier.
document_type.delivery_receipt: Delivery receipt signed at the warehouse; evidence for G5.
document_type.gate_approval: The customer's written approval of a gate (e-mail or e-signature).
document_type.change_request: Change request (CR): a versioned change to spec, design, packaging or price.
document_type.contract: Contract with a customer or supplier (MSA, SOW, NDA).

document_status.signed: Signed, stamped, sent from the official e-mail and dated.
document_status.approved: Accepted; an approved spec sheet must also be signed.
document_status.superseded: Replaced by a newer version; kept, never deleted.

supplier_status.suspended: No new orders until the issue is resolved.

customer_status.paused: Work is on hold for now.
customer_status.closed: Relationship ended; no new project can be opened.

product_status.concept: An idea or concept; not developed yet.
product_status.development: Being developed or sampled with the supplier.
product_status.approved: Sample and spec approved; ready to order.
product_status.ordering: Ordered; in production or on the way.
product_status.archived: No longer used; its GTIN can be given again.

task_status.blocked: Cannot go on until something else is resolved.
